//AllowedHosts: SuHarness is a single-user tool with no authentication in front of a shell tool, so it is only ever meant to answer requests aimed at the loopback interface. Restricting the accepted Host header is what makes that true in practice: with '*' the app answers any hostname, which lets a page on the public internet point a name it controls at 127.0.0.1 and reach this origin from the victim's browser. Widen this only alongside real authentication.
